title: Chale Aao Asghar
body:
Hui raat ban me andhera hai dilbar..
chale aao Asghar Chale aao Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bayabaañ me dhoondhe Kahañ tumko Madar
Chale aao Asghar Chale aao Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tumhare Bina maañ ye kaise jiyegi, wo aahe bharegi..
Tumhe yaad karke wo royegi aksar...
Cahale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(1)
<<DIVIDER>>
Lo Sughra ne bheja hai tohfe me kurta, mere Pyare beta..
Kahañ shahe deeñ ne ye turbat Pe jakar..
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai Awaaz deti hun reh-rehke tumko, kyu sunte nahi ho..
Batao ke roothe ho kyu maañ Se dilbar...
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaha kho Gaye ho sar e Shaam Jake, Tumhe Kon doondhe..
Nahi Ghar me koi na kasim na Akbar..
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitamgar ne tera jalaya hai jhula, magar mere beta...
Jhulaungi hatho Ko Jhula banaker..
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(5)
<<DIVIDER>>
Thake ho kaleje Se Tumko laga lu, Mai lori suna du..
Sula du Mai hatho se Tumko thapak kar
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
Akele ho beta Kahi dar na Jao, mere Paas aao..
Sataye na Tumko Kahiñ ye Sitamgar..
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(7)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab aise hamari badhao na Mushkil, Hai zakhmi Mera Dil..
Tum aa jao to Kuch Sukooñ ho mayassar Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar
(8)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jigar maañ ka kamzor Hota hai beta, nahi sabr Hota..
Rakhu kaise Mai apne seene Pe patthar
Chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(9)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai pardes me maañ bahot door Ghar hai Ye Tumko khabar hai
Turab o Azadaar rote hain kehker..
chale aao Asghar
Chale aao Asghar(10)
